description: Execute a live eth_call and eth_estimateGas dry-run on Base or Ethereum BEFORE signing or broadcasting an unsigned transaction. Use this immediately before wallet execution when you have target `to` + `data` and need to confirm whether the call will succeed, estimate gas, and verify allowance safety (100 free calls/day/IP). Returns simulation success, gas estimate, decoded revert reason if any, and recommendedAgentAction. Do NOT use for standalone hex bytes without `to` or past mined tx hashes (use nullclear_decode_calldata).

data.description: 0x-prefixed hex calldata payload for the simulated call

from.description: Sender 0x EVM address whose balance/allowance context will be simulated

to.description: Destination 0x smart contract or recipient address

value.description: Native wei amount as hex ('0x0') or decimal string

name: nullclear_simulate_transaction
